svg.title: A 2-year tree, 6097 commits, 10 ripening persimmons, 4 lanterns for code reviews.
svg.desc: A bonsai grown from the public GitHub history of grinder, drawn for 2026-07-15. Season: summer. Weather: calm. Maturity level 4 of 13, in a clay pot. Plaques on the pot rim: commits1k. Every element is recomputable from public history; nothing here is random or purchasable.
